in_sanskrit.name: Ishanvi
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God, ruler
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Ishanvi एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Ishanvi is derived from the name Ishan, which means god or ruler in Sanskrit. In Hinduism, Ishan is one of the five directions and the presiding deity of the north. Ishanvi can also represent the sun god, Surya, who is believed to be the source of all energy and life.
